name: United Nations
detail: The Institute participates in United Nations AI and data-governance work at the “By Regulation” stage of its four-phase strategy. At this stage, principle-level commitments are translated into public, national-scale frameworks.

name: European Commission
detail: European Commission AI policy work spans the AI Act, Data Act, Digital Services Act and Cyber Resilience Act.

name: ACM
detail: ACM's Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct and its technology-policy work set expectations for computing professionals broadly. The nine Responsible AI Principles provide ML-specific commitments that practitioners and organisations can apply alongside ACM's professional-conduct baseline.

name: Linux Foundation
detail: The Institute's collaboration with Linux Foundation AI & Data includes two open-source projects. Kompute is cross-vendor GPU acceleration work maintained alongside LF AI & Data and NumFOCUS. The MLSecOps Top 10 was connected to LF's Trusted AI work and an ML-security committee.

name: OWASP
detail: The MLSecOps Top 10 maps ten vulnerability classes from OWASP categories onto the ML lifecycle, from unrestricted model endpoints to supply-chain risk in ML code.

name: IEEE
detail: The Institute participates in IEEE AI standards work.

name: ISO/IEC
detail: The Institute participates in ISO/IEC AI standards work, which sets the formal, cross-industry baseline for how AI systems are assessed and governed. AI-RFX and the ML Maturity Model are compatible with that baseline.

name: NumFOCUS
detail: Kompute is cross-vendor GPU acceleration work maintained alongside Linux Foundation AI & Data and NumFOCUS.

name: TUM / TUM IEAI
detail: The TUM Institute for Ethics in Artificial Intelligence's speaker series covers research and practice in responsible AI.

links.label: Speaker series on the state of responsible AI
